reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual comparison of the exact 65x67 source PNG, enlarged existing source-page 15 and targeted source-note crop, complete unchanged 2048x2048 raw RGBA and native note/right-edge crop, full white/cyan/alpha sheet and evidence, and unchanged naiwa.png; checked two silver cap badges, covered/short temple hair, brows, clean-shaven face, broad open smile, military collar, collar fit, backplate, note footprint and missing right tab.

remaining_reasons: The returned native note adds a separate small gray dash below the left side of the second main upper row, outside the original compact upper footprint. The enlarged original has no such independent lower dash. Remove that added mark and restore only the source's existing faint mark groups and original blank areas.

The source's small dark right-edge note tab is absent from the returned note's worn right edge. Restore the original compact dark tab and its position/form without substituting a torn notch, plain worn paper or new hardware.
entries.positive_observation: The dark gray-green cap retains two silver-toned front badges, silver braid/piping and a glossy dark visor with a pale reflection. Only short dark temple/sideburn hair is visible, with dark brows, no glasses, no moustache or beard and one broad slightly open smile. The slight-left bust presentation, direct friendly gaze, original cap-to-upper-chest crop and visor shadow remain. The dark gray-green military jacket retains pale gray-white front/collar areas and dark light-outlined patterned collar details. The rounded chin meets a short broad fitted collar without a stalk or pinching. The dark gray-green photographic backplate and thin dark frame remain opaque. Full white/cyan comparisons show no visible interior holes, lost backing or working-matte ring; the added lower-left note dash and missing right tab remain separate visible rejection reasons.
entries.visible_limitations: Exact motifs inside tiny cap and collar insignia and note glyphs are unreadable at 65x67 and are not rejection grounds. The rejection relies on the clearly resolved independent lower dash and absent right-edge tab in native/enlarged comparisons, not on glyph interpretation or alpha numbers.
